title: Workflow action refresh and review reconciliation

tasks.title: Refresh workflow action SHAs and reconcile review state
tasks.goal: Absorb the pending GitHub Actions SHA refreshes through declared sprint scope, keep every workflow pinned by immutable SHA, and reconcile review evidence with the post-PR-14 repository state.

agentGoal.draft: /goal Refresh the pinned workflow action SHAs and reconcile docs/REVIEW.md with the post-PR-14 repository state, verified by local non-test validators and GitHub PR checks.
agentGoal.outcome: The open workflow SHA bumps no longer fail validate:scope, workflows remain pinned by immutable SHA, and docs/REVIEW.md reflects the current mainline baseline instead of the old PR #11 snapshot.
agentGoal.verificationSurface: npm run doctor, npm run validate:templates, npm run validate:context, npm run validate:state, npm run validate:secrets, npm run validate:scope, npm run validate:workflows, npm run validate:adapters, npm run validate:docs, npm run validate:license, git diff --check and gh pr checks
constraints: Do not run npm test or npm run validate locally on this workstation.
Do not perform a deploy or publish a release.
agentGoal.iterationPolicy: Declare only the files needed for the workflow refresh and review-state reconciliation, then verify with the light local gates plus GitHub CI.
agentGoal.blockedStopCondition: Stop if the refresh requires files outside the declared scope or if GitHub CI fails for a root cause unrelated to the workflow SHA updates.

acceptanceCriteria: The pending workflow action refreshes are absorbed through declared sprint scope while every workflow keeps immutable SHA pins.
Review evidence and changelog reflect the post-PR-14 baseline and the new workflow-refresh slice instead of keeping the old PR #11 snapshot as the current state.
Git diff scope and the light local validators pass for the workflow-refresh branch, and GitHub PR checks pass before merge.
